segment_text: 4.23 Technical Support. Vendor will provide, at no additional cost to AT&T, full and complete technical assistance to AT&T for the Material and Services provisioned under this Agreement, including ongoing technical support and field service and assistance, and telephone assistance to assist with installation, operation, maintenance and problem resolution as set forth in the terms of the Maintenance Addendum. The availability or performance of this technical support will not be construed as altering or affecting Vendor's obligations as set forth in the "Warranty" Section or as provided elsewhere in this Agreement. Field Service and technical support, including emergency support (service affecting), will be available on call twenty-four (24) hours a day. Vendor will provide to AT&T, and keep current, an escalation document that includes names, titles and telephone numbers, including after-hours telephone numbers, of Vendor personnel responsible for providing technical support to AT&T. Vendor will maintain a streamlined escalation process to speed resolution of reported problems.

annotator_notes:
COMPOUND ACTION (section 8.3): the sentence imposes two duties on one object -- 'provide to AT&T' (one-time PROVIDE) and 'and keep current' (ongoing MAINTAIN, a real taxonomy verb). Annotated on the primary verb PROVIDE; the dropped duty is verbatim 'and keep current'. Section 8.3 itself is DRAFTER'S JUDGMENT -- the ruling was requested three times and not given -- so both this tag and the rule are reversible at batch review. Under the rejected two-item option this segment would hold FOUR duties and fail section 2's 1-3 band, which would retroactively exclude C03-01 as well.

RULED 2026-08-22 (B1): ONE item, confirmed by the reviewer. The underlying test was already decided by M2 -- §4.3's performance-identity test names this exact sentence as one item -- and F2 confirms the compound_action tag correctly stays, because 'provide'->PROVIDE and 'keep current'->MAINTAIN are DIFFERENT taxonomy verbs so a verb is genuinely lost. The rejected two-item reading would give the segment FOUR duties, fail §2's 1-3 band, and retroactively exclude C03-01 as well. Recorded on the reviewer's own acknowledgement: the ruling had been requested three times and not given, which is why this note existed at all.
